description: Look up the description, severity, OWASP category, CWE, and remediation guidance for a specific XploitScan rule by its rule ID (e.g. 'VC005' for unprotected Stripe webhooks, 'VC006' for SQL injection). Use this when a user asks what a specific finding means or how to fix it. For a Pro rule when no paid XPLOITSCAN_API_KEY is set, only the OWASP/CWE mapping and a documentation link are returned.
name: explain_rule
